hairline-create.summary: Draws a new isometric line figure that reacts to the pointer, delivered as a single self-contained HTML file.
hairline-create.example: /hairline-create a filing cabinet whose drawers slide open on hover

hairline-adopt.summary: Rebuilds an existing SVG icon, logo or illustration as an interactive isometric Hairline figure.

archify.summary: Creates validated architecture, workflow, sequence, ERD, state and timeline diagrams as explorable HTML, plus one-page explainers and code-backed architecture analysis.
archify.example: Draw the request flow of this repo's API as an archify diagram

archify-pr.summary: Explains a branch diff or pull request with visual architecture, flow, schema and lifecycle walkthroughs you can attach to the PR.
archify-pr.example: Explain PR #42 with an archify walkthrough

diagram-design.summary: Makes editorial, on-brand diagrams and charts in 50+ types as HTML/SVG/PNG, and redraws draw.io, Mermaid, Excalidraw and PlantUML files.
diagram-design.example: Make a Wardley map of our platform in our brand colors
